n1.text: Prev/next chapter are fixed at both ends of the progress row and never scroll away. Four labelled actions + MORE (auto-scroll, rotation, scroll to top, edit). Titles end in an ellipsis. Order of the four is user-configurable (existing bottom-bar setting).

n2.text: Shown at the end of every chapter when infinite scroll is off (replaces the light-blue #ADD8E6 Android button). Themed, full width, 56 dp, names the next chapter. Swipe-up past the end does the same.

n3.text: CUSTOM opens From / To fields that take chapter NUMBERS (not list positions), with −/+ steppers and a 'from where I am' shortcut. Validation inline. The two app-wide switches move to 'Download settings ›'.

n4.text: The LNReader 'Default' shelf is merged into the built-in Default on import (and a one-time fix merges existing ones). Library becomes a nav tab; nav labels are real words. The selected pill slides (one indicator, translationX), it doesn't resize the row.

n5.text: Toolbar: download, filter, overflow only (scroll/next-unread move to the overflow). Tiles with no data (N/A) are hidden. One Resume (the floating one goes). Genres wrap to two lines. Mixed-case text uses the body font, not Doto caps, so long text stays readable.

n7.text: Tabs get words (TEXT · PAGE · CONTROLS). All six page colours fit in one row with names. Size and line spacing show the real unit (sp, ×) the same way as All settings. RESET returns this book to defaults.

n8.text: Full-screen, labelled tabs TEXT · PAGE · CONTROLS · LISTEN · MORE instead of five unlabelled icons. Labels sit above controls so nothing wraps mid-word ('Rende/ring mode'). Rarely used items fold into 'Fine-tune'.

n9.text: One list of page colours (ours) replaces Tsundoku's Theme + Font colour + Background colour lists. Custom stays as the last swatch and opens a text/background picker. Margins become one control: Sides and Top/Bottom.

n10.text: Only Colour and Dot. Mihon/Tsundoku themes (Default, Monet, Catppuccin, Tako…) are no longer offered; anyone using one moves to Colour on update. Light/dark/system mode stays.

n6.text: Media switch (NOVELS | MANGA) above a two-item segmented control (SOURCES | EXTENSIONS), so nothing scrolls off screen. Source names get the full width; LATEST is a compact chip.

cnote.text: Same layouts as Dot. Colour: book background (default navy #1C2B4A), tiles rgba(255,255,255,.08) with no border, accent = book colour (default gold #E9B44C) with text in the background colour, Instrument Serif italic headings, Manrope body, covers in colour, no dot grid. In the app, Colour labels use sentence case, not the uppercase drawn here.
